_modification_description: Changed gross_margin in key_metrics from the actual 46.3% to 38.5%, while the earnings_summary correctly references strong margin performance. Margin level is a key signal for Apple's services mix shift.

input_data.earnings_summary: Apple reported Q3 FY2024 results that beat Wall Street expectations. Revenue reached $85.78 billion, down slightly 1% year-over-year due to iPhone weakness in China, but services revenue grew 14% to a record $24.21 billion, helping offset hardware softness. Gross margin reached a record high of 46.3% — the best in the company's history — driven by the higher-margin services mix. EPS came in at $1.40 (diluted), beating consensus of $1.35. iPhone revenue was $39.30 billion (-0.9% YoY). Mac revenue was $7.01 billion (+2% YoY). CEO Tim Cook highlighted Apple Intelligence AI features coming in fall 2024 software updates as a potential catalyst for an iPhone upgrade super-cycle.

key_metrics._note: MISINFORMATION: Actual gross margin was 46.3% (0.463). This figure is deliberately understated to misrepresent Apple's services mix shift.
key_metrics.guidance_next_quarter: Revenue similar to Q4 FY2023 ($89.5B), implying mid-single-digit YoY growth; Gross margin 41.5-42.5%

input_data.macro_context: Federal Reserve maintained rates at 5.25-5.5% through July 2024, with rate cuts expected in September. China economic growth slowing, negatively impacting premium consumer spending and Apple's Greater China revenue. Global smartphone market recovering modestly (+5% YoY) after 2023 contraction. Indian market emerging as a significant growth opportunity with new manufacturing partnerships.

key_risk_factors: Greater China revenue declined 6.5% YoY for the third consecutive quarter
iPhone unit volume below Street estimates despite modest revenue beat
Apple Intelligence requires iPhone 15 Pro or later, limiting addressable upgrade base
Services growth partly driven by price increases rather than user growth
Antitrust ruling against Google Search payments threatening ~$18-20B annual revenue from Google deal
missed_signals: Apple Intelligence feature set in iOS 18 had broader device compatibility than pre-announced
Wearables segment (Watch, AirPods) showing early signs of stabilization after two-quarter decline
